text: DSH annotations 是面向 DSH Web 的文本批注插件：用户可在已完成的助手回复中选取一段文字并添加评论。插件在对话界面显示批注编辑器、待发送列表和已发送标记，保存的批注会以原生引用标记附加到输入框，并可与普通文字或单独发送。发送后的标记可查看引用和评论，并导航回原文。适合需要在对话中引用回复片段并补充说明的 DSH Web 用户。批注内容随普通用户消息提交。

DSH annotations lets DSH Web users comment on selected assistant reply passages. Notes attach to the composer as reference chips and travel with an ordinary user message. Submitted labels show the quote and comment and link back to the source. The plugin adds an editor and pending notes list.
我想给助手回复里的一段话加个评论，之后能在原文旁边找到它。
能不能把我标注的回复片段和补充说明一起发到对话里？
I want to comment on a passage in an assistant reply and jump back to it later.
DSH annotations 的功能「回复片段批注」：在已完成的助手回复中选择文字并打开编辑器，保存评论后形成待发送批注。批注保留引用原文及位置，可编辑或删除。
DSH annotations 的功能「随消息发送并回看」：待发送批注作为输入框中的引用标记附加，随普通用户消息提交；发送后可查看引用和评论，并点击标记导航回助手原文。
DSH annotations 使用前须知：批注评论、引用原文和定位信息会随普通用户消息提交，实际接收服务取决于当前会话配置。

@jin1254/dsh-annotations README · DSH annotations：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Select assistant text in DSH Web, add a comment, and send it with your next message. Compact labels show the original quote and comment on hover and navigate back to the source on click.

@jin1254/dsh-annotations README · Compatibility：Verified against the official **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 Web UI**. This community plugin requires no host patches or custom APIs and is not affiliated with DeepSeek. Other releases and desktop distributions are unverified.

@jin1254/dsh-annotations README · Compatibility：This distribution uses native reference chips: saving a comment automatically attaches a compact label to the composer whose click expands or collapses the note list above it. Each row places a left-aligned gray comment beside its quote with a gap; long quotes use at most a quarter of the text area. Long text is truncated. Click the quote to read the source or edit the comment to read its full text. Pending rows have no hover cards; sent labels retain their previews. Comments are never written into editable text. A label-only draft can be submitted with Enter or Send, and ordinary text can accompany it. The history navigator receives a readable annotation title.

@jin1254/dsh-annotations README · Use：1. Select a passage in a completed assistant reply and choose **Add to conversation**.
2. Write a comment. Enter saves, Escape cancels, and Shift+Enter inserts a newline.
3. Click the composer reference chip to expand or collapse the pending-note list. Click a row’s quote to navigate; its buttons edit or delete the comment. The blue number also reopens the editor above the original text.
4. Continue typing in the main composer or submit the labels alone. Sent labels expose hover previews and source navigation.

@jin1254/dsh-annotations README · Use：Opening or reopening **Edit annotation** focuses the comment field without scrolling the conversation. The editor fills its compact rounded panel and grows with the text up to the viewport limits; its footer contains Delete, Cancel, and Save. Delete discards a new unsaved comment or removes the note being edited. Source navigation remains in the pending list and historical labels; navigation from the bottom aligns the selected text, including inside long paragraphs. Successful admission clears this round’s blue markers and restarts the next round at 1; historical labels retain their source coordinates.

@jin1254/dsh-annotations README · Use：Unsent notes stay in this browser and do not synchronize between devices. Native submission failure restores reference chips. If closing the page or cancellation leaves admission uncertain, inspect the conversation before explicitly attaching the notes again. Disable other annotation plugins while using this one.

@jin1254/dsh-annotations README · Install：Release archives contain prebuilt artifacts and run no install scripts. Download the `.tgz` asset from this repository’s Releases and install through `dsh plugin --profile web add <archive-path> --ignore-scripts`. Follow DSH’s restart instructions and refresh the page.

@jin1254/dsh-annotations README · Model input：Annotations travel in one ordinary user message: optional composer text, a readable title, and a versioned `dsh-annotations` JSON text block. Each note contains its number, exact quote, source coordinates, and comment. No system or tool message is added. Quoted text consumes input tokens.

@jin1254/dsh-annotations README · Known limitations：- Compatibility is currently declared only for 0.2.1-rc.2. Source navigation uses that release’s existing Chat node markers; ambiguous sources retain their comments and report a navigation failure.
- Reasoning, tool cards, cross-message selections, and mobile selection gestures are unsupported. Browsers without CSS Custom Highlights retain comments without a text fill.

@jin1254/dsh-annotations README · Development and validation：Sources live in `src/`; `scripts/build.mjs` builds the Host entry and browser module factory. After installing development dependencies, run `pnpm run build`, `pnpm run typecheck`, and `pnpm test`. The committed `lib/` artifacts share React and services with the host.

@jin1254/dsh-annotations README · Development and validation：For Web regression, separately clone and build the official 0.2.1-rc.2 checkout, set `DSH_TEST_HARNESS` to that directory, and run `pnpm run test:web`. Tests use temporary profiles, assigned ports, and recorded model replies; they access no real user data or paid model. The test adapter is created temporarily inside that isolated checkout and removed afterward.

MIT. The original DeepSeek copyright notice is retained; jin1254 maintains this community adaptation.
